scope: 61 prepared routes. Historical captures provide triage evidence. Track A verification is recorded separately.
qualification: controllerVerified refers to the intended launch mode and end-to-end controller software. Physical hardware has a separate flag. Tier 3 includes plausible native candidates awaiting Track B.

games.title: ClockWerx 1.0
games.priorBrowserEvidence: QA100 retained sweep previously matched all 100 port scenes.
games.disposition: Default to HTML5. Complete the physical-controller and couch-distance display checks. Keep the emulated route as a future override for original saves.

games.title: Koji the Frog 2.0.4
games.priorBrowserEvidence: First lily-pad field ran, including enemies and respawns. Browser keyboard aliases cover movement and actions.
games.disposition: Verify jump, diagonal movement, pause and any mapped preferences on a fresh native start.

trackANativeSmoke.observation: Level 1 showed movement, tongue and pause. The scenario passed both its pixel and guest audio assertions.

games.title: Delirium 1.1
games.priorBrowserEvidence: Classic playfield and saved keypad steering were exercised. The OtterTube browser harness proved scripted start and guest Quit before leaving.
games.disposition: Map keypad movement and fire, bomb, reverse and thrust. Verify the name flow and actual high-score write on guest Quit.

trackANativeSmoke.observation: The script reached the arena and showed movement/fire and resume. The script supplied the catalogue’s 2,048,000-byte partition.

games.title: 3-D Cannon
games.priorBrowserEvidence: One-player terrain and aim changes were seen. The view changed after Space.
games.disposition: Qualify aim, power, fire and view selection with a stick and a short start script.

games.title: 3d Brick Bash! 1.1.1
games.priorBrowserEvidence: Aiming drag changed the rendered polygon into a broad band. No dependable paddle or collision baseline.
games.disposition: Reproduce the distortion against the original before committing to a cursor or paddle mapping.

games.title: Acquire 1.0
games.priorBrowserEvidence: First timed board responds to target selection and continues to generate icons.
games.disposition: Test at couch distance with precision cursor movement and target acquisition.

games.title: Alien Action Dome 1.0
games.priorBrowserEvidence: Stage 1 proceeded through a life loss to the score screen.
games.disposition: Verify continuous steering and the restart and score-dialog paths.

games.title: Adventure 1.1
games.priorBrowserEvidence: A titled but blank window persisted. No text prompt appeared.
games.disposition: Investigate startup. Reassess controller suitability once the command interface is available.

games.title: Angband 2.0.2 (Macintosh)
games.priorBrowserEvidence: A new character reached town and awaited turns.
games.disposition: Character creation, inventory and the broad keyboard command set need a dedicated UI before couch qualification.

games.title: Arashi 1.1.1
games.priorBrowserEvidence: The selected tube level responded to mouse input before the score prompt.
games.disposition: Try direct horizontal positioning and a holdable fire button, then verify precision.

games.title: Bachman 2.0u
games.priorBrowserEvidence: The maze animated and reached game over in the first level.
games.disposition: Script Game → Begin and confirm directional changes and restarts.

games.title: Balderdoush 1.04i
games.priorBrowserEvidence: The first field stayed active across an idle sample and a right input.
games.disposition: Confirm movement, firing and cleanup of the high-score prompt.

games.title: Barney Carnage 2.0
games.priorBrowserEvidence: The scene ran at roughly 5 guest Hz with only a small moving target on a mostly white field.
games.disposition: A rendering and timing reference is needed before judging playability or rewrite size.

games.title: BattleTanks 2.12.1
games.priorBrowserEvidence: Two-player New Game enabled save commands but produced a flat field without units.
games.disposition: Establish an active arena before mapping movement and targeting.

games.title: Bedlam 1.1
games.priorBrowserEvidence: A monochrome briefing and sparse star transition appeared. Cockpit combat did not appear.
games.disposition: Find a reliable transition into combat and identify the flight and firing inputs.

games.title: Bikaka 1.4
games.priorBrowserEvidence: The first falling hex piece rendered at roughly 26 guest Hz.
games.disposition: Conversion priority 2. Compare native drop timing first, then prototype hex rotation, line clears and responsive digital repeat on one board.

games.title: Blobbo Full 1.0.1
games.priorBrowserEvidence: The welcome board responded to mouse movement. OtterTube verified grid pulses and scripted save/load in the browser.
games.disposition: Port stick_step and the dialog scripts. Test native gameplay and actual persistence of root Preferences.

trackANativeSmoke.observation: Startup reached About. The 640×480 desktop run dismissed About, wrote a game save, closed and restored one snapshot.

games.title: Blood Bath Demo 1.96
games.priorBrowserEvidence: The explicitly selected demo still showed a partial red title screen.
games.disposition: Isolate the presentation failure before assessing aiming.

games.title: Bloodsuckers
games.priorBrowserEvidence: The animated title menu persisted after attempted selection.
games.disposition: Find a reliable transition to the in-game arm and meters.

games.title: Bolo 0.99.7
games.priorBrowserEvidence: Offline tutorial reached the river and the boat responded to a stop command.
games.disposition: Qualify steering, aiming, builder commands and tutorial dialogs with dual-stick input.

games.title: Bonk 1.4.2
games.priorBrowserEvidence: The face grid displayed then returned to the chooser.
games.disposition: Identify the return trigger and check precise selection across several rounds.

games.title: Bonkheads Deluxe 1.0.0
games.priorBrowserEvidence: One-player Surfaceville remained active with moving enemies.
games.disposition: Verify jump and attack timing, pause, restart and the distinction between single-player and co-op.

games.title: Brickles Plus 3.0
games.priorBrowserEvidence: Score and ball counts changed, with bricks disappearing, but the paddle and ball were unclear in both browser and historical native captures.
games.disposition: Conversion priority 8. Confirm the renderer gap against the original. A bounded single-paddle port could deliver visible ball/paddle feedback and analog positioning.

games.title: Brickoids Millenium 1.1
games.priorBrowserEvidence: Level 1 advanced after the ball launched, and score and ball count changed.
games.disposition: Test an analog paddle and confirm ball visibility, launch and pause.

games.title: Chiral 1.0.1
games.priorBrowserEvidence: One atom was placed in Practice 1 before the sample ended at the title.
games.disposition: Test placement, precision and pause under faster stages.

games.title: Chrysanthemum 1.01
games.priorBrowserEvidence: The first flower-arrangement field appeared without clearly visible flowers. About 14 guest Hz was diagnostic only.
games.disposition: Resolve resource or presentation behavior before estimating playability.

games.title: Columns 1.0
games.priorBrowserEvidence: Gems fell into the well. Earlier native probes held pause and then resumed motion.
games.disposition: Confirm rotation, lateral repeat, fast drop and score prompt handling.

games.title: Crunch! 2.0
games.priorBrowserEvidence: The marble moved right and Space pause/resume was seen.
games.disposition: Check directional feel, collision and restart at native pace.

games.title: CyberNation 1.1.1
games.priorBrowserEvidence: First room and NPC state advanced after a right input.
games.disposition: Confirm movement, attack and pause from a known scene.

games.title: Deliverance™ 1.0
games.priorBrowserEvidence: Installation stops at a serial prompt.
games.disposition: Keep hidden until there is an authorized registered setup and gameplay proof.

games.title: Dome Wars Public Beta
games.priorBrowserEvidence: Terrain rendered and the first human turn accepted a power adjustment.
games.disposition: Try cursor and aim/power bindings. Check turn setup and fire without typing.

games.title: Drol 0.9
games.priorBrowserEvidence: Initial platforms and enemies remained active after starting and input.
games.disposition: Verify direction, action and pause on the first stage.

games.title: Fantastic Voyage 1.1a
games.priorBrowserEvidence: The first mission room ran at roughly 15 guest Hz with active actors and a timer.
games.disposition: Conversion priority 7. Retest native pacing and movement first. Bound a feasibility slice to one room, rescue objectives and one controller action loop.

games.title: Gold Digger 1.3.0
games.priorBrowserEvidence: The first Lost Mines board rendered with the player and enemies.
games.disposition: Confirm movement, digging controls, pause and completion on a stock map.

games.title: GoldPusher 1.5
games.priorBrowserEvidence: The populated first room progressed and the score changed.
games.disposition: Measure single-cell movement and repeat. Add a safe undo or restart mapping if the game supports it.

games.title: Guy Smiley vs. the Monsters 1.0.1
games.priorBrowserEvidence: New Game left a white client after a movement attempt.
games.disposition: Investigate initialization and wait states before assigning arcade inputs.

games.title: Lawyers 1.0
games.priorBrowserEvidence: A randomized board rendered and awaited a turn.
games.disposition: Qualify single-step movement and restart without replacing existing game state.

games.title: Lemmings 1.5.2
games.priorBrowserEvidence: First Fun level advanced with the release count and countdown changing.
games.disposition: Verify skill selection, cursor precision, actual assignment and pause at couch distance.

trackANativeSmoke.observation: The scenario reached Fun level 1 and observed release count changes and pause/resume. Skill assignment remained inconclusive.

games.title: MacPipes 2.2.7
games.priorBrowserEvidence: The shareware reminder returned after dismissal.
games.disposition: Require a repeatable authorized start before evaluating pipe selection.

games.title: Maelstrom 1.4.3
games.priorBrowserEvidence: Wave 1 advanced to a life loss in the browser.
games.disposition: Verify rotation, thrust, fire and pause, plus keyboard-to-pad input cadence.

trackANativeSmoke.observation: The start key entered Wave 1. The desktop store gained one startup snapshot; its restoration was outside this probe.

games.title: Mantra 1.02
games.priorBrowserEvidence: The initial beach and status UI rendered.
games.disposition: Confirm discrete movement and repeat, then dialog dismissal and save behavior.

games.title: Mantra II 1.02
games.priorBrowserEvidence: Keypad movement changed the actor location in the native follow-up. Browser play reached a conversation.
games.disposition: Try stick_step and confirm/cancel for NPC interactions. The prepared entry selects the 68K application.

trackANativeSmoke.observation: PPC was confirmed by the runner and the title rendered. The prepared route keeps the selected 68K executable.

games.title: Nort
games.priorBrowserEvidence: The browser entered a persistent black field. A historical headless run reached a split arena after delay.
games.disposition: Reconcile the two starts and prove steering before exposing the game.

games.title: Oh No! More Lemmings 1.0
games.priorBrowserEvidence: The first Tame level progressed. Earlier native capture proved pause and resume.
games.disposition: Validate skill cycling, cursor assignment and nuke confirmation with the Lemmings profile.

games.title: Oregon Trail 1.1
games.priorBrowserEvidence: The wagon travelled on the map, with roughly 24 guest Hz in the measured scene.
games.disposition: Conversion priority 6. Verify native travel and hunting first. A slice should cover readable prompts, a no-typing party setup and one coherent travel decision loop.

games.title: Pac-in-Time 1.0
games.priorBrowserEvidence: A first-desert platform scene and a right input were observed at roughly 46 guest Hz.
games.disposition: Conversion priority 5. Compare native jump, momentum and item use first. Full levels and physics make this a larger rewrite.

games.title: Pac the Man 4.5.1
games.priorBrowserEvidence: Opening maze accepted a right input and advanced through lives and score changes.
games.disposition: Qualify directional turns at intersections, pause/restart and name prompt handling.

games.title: ParticleMan 1.0
games.priorBrowserEvidence: A populated board and changing counters appeared. The directional mapping remains uncertain.
games.disposition: Identify movement and actions from the game controls, then verify a representative board.

games.title: Polybrid 1.0
games.priorBrowserEvidence: A live falling well reached roughly 29 guest Hz after startup.
games.disposition: Conversion priority 3. Test native timing, then prototype one well with precise repeat, rotate and drop.

games.title: Prince of Persia 1.0
games.priorBrowserEvidence: The first room booted and a right input was observed in the browser. A prior native probe reached Escape pause.
games.disposition: Map the start chord and verify walk/run, jump, careful step, fight, and resume.

trackANativeSmoke.observation: The New Game chord entered the first dungeon room and Escape showed pause. Movement displacement remained inconclusive.

games.title: RoboWar 4.1.1
games.priorBrowserEvidence: Supplied robots fought in a live arena. Loading and editing programs remains a keyboard/file workflow.
games.disposition: Keep experimental for general couch use. Assess a scripted preset-battle mode separately.

games.title: Ruckus
games.priorBrowserEvidence: Mission 9 displayed the terrain and scrolled to a hostage building.
games.disposition: Verify command selection, panning and vehicle control with dual sticks and a cursor.

games.title: Scruffy
games.priorBrowserEvidence: The monochrome puppy field rendered and moved after a D input.
games.disposition: Retain 1-bit depth and verify jump, movement and restart.

games.title: Scruffy II 1.0
games.priorBrowserEvidence: A 4-bit title appeared. Bounded clicks and keys did not reach gameplay.
games.disposition: Resolve how the mode starts and retain 4-bit depth.

games.title: Slithereens
games.priorBrowserEvidence: Only a uniform pale-cyan screen was observed after startup and New Game input.
games.disposition: Investigate readiness and rendering before inferring a gamepad layout.

games.title: Spin Doctor 1.2
games.priorBrowserEvidence: The two-wand scene rendered four rotating hands at roughly 24 guest Hz. A native probe observed a pause screen.
games.disposition: Conversion priority 1. Recheck native timing, then trial transfer windows and control feel on one wand course. Evaluate rule reuse from ClockWerx.

games.title: Star Trek: A Final Unity
games.priorBrowserEvidence: The large two-volume package mounted, but output stayed mostly black or white at roughly 9 guest Hz.
games.disposition: Treat as a compatibility case. Recover game presentation before estimating a high-effort conversion.

games.title: Super Munchers
games.priorBrowserEvidence: The Animals board accepted right and the earlier native probe proved eating feedback and pause/resume. Browser rate was roughly 19 guest Hz.
games.disposition: Conversion priority 4. Check native timing and the picture fault first. Bound a prototype to one ruleset, grid repeat and readable feedback.

games.title: System's Twilight 1.0.5
games.priorBrowserEvidence: New Game opened a Standard File dialog, then reported error -1303 after accepting a disposable name.
games.disposition: Fix new-game file creation before judging any puzzle cursor profile.

games.title: The Big One Demo 1.0
games.priorBrowserEvidence: At 1-bit, the demo showed player displacement and shots. Higher-depth presentation was incomplete.
games.disposition: Retain 1-bit and verify movement plus fire through a full demo loop.

games.title: Zap'T'Balls
games.priorBrowserEvidence: The mouse-click round ran through to a score prompt.
games.disposition: Check cursor precision, repeated rounds, and a controller-only exit from score entry.
